description: Puntos de recarga de coche eléctrico is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de San Lorenzo de El Escorial. List of charging points for electric vehicles available in the municipality of San Lorenzo de El Escorial. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de San Lorenzo de El Escorial. The portal shows the English title as "Electric car charging points" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de San Lorenzo de El Escorial. Its keywords include recarga, electricidad, movilidad sostenible, puntos de recarga, vehículo eléctrico. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, XLSX. The listing shows 2026-01-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
